method: the DSH provider/credential environment was inspected, the pi-ai provider catalog was enumerated, and each candidate route was exercised END-TO-END through a real DSH headless worker in an isolated DSH home. No secret value is recorded anywhere in this file.

environment.note: only the credential NAMES are recorded; the values are supplied by the DSH credential plane and are never read by the harness
environment.piAiProviderCatalog: 386 openrouter models, 41 openai, 15 anthropic, 30 opencode-go, 2 deepseek, and others, shipped in @earendil-works/pi-ai 0.87.1

gatewayProbe.note: a single completion per model, to separate 'the route answers' from 'the route is usable in a worker'

endToEndVerification.note: §8 forbids silently substituting another model, so a route counts only after it completed a real DSH worker task. Each verification ran in an isolated DSH home with a generated profile and the common renderer.

deepseek-flash.textTask: PASS — replied with the requested token
deepseek-flash.toolTask: PASS — read a file and wrote the requested token to a new file

glm-5.3-flash.textTask: PASS — replied with the requested token
glm-5.3-flash.toolTask: PASS — read src.js and wrote out.txt containing the requested token

kimi-k3.toolTask: NOT VERIFIED end-to-end in a DSH worker in this stage

materialDistinctness.requirement: families must differ in at least one of: tool-use post-training, reasoning architecture, vendor/model family, capability level
materialDistinctness.deepseek: DeepSeek vendor; native deepseek reasoning-content channel
materialDistinctness.glm: Zhipu / Z.ai vendor; non-DeepSeek reasoning formatting through an OpenAI-compatible surface; distinct post-training lineage

incidents.symptom: a probe home without the profiles/node_modules junction booted to `NO_ADAPTER: no adapter registered for provider "omnigate"`
incidents.cause: the pi-ai plugin could not resolve its own package from a home lacking the shared node_modules junction the gates create
incidents.resolution: the junction was created exactly as installHostBundle does; the route then completed tasks
incidents.note: recorded because the failure mode is silent and would otherwise be mistaken for a model-availability result

incidents.symptom: one early probe appeared to succeed and then failed on a repeat run
incidents.cause: the first probe ran against a home whose plugin resolution happened to succeed before the junction was added
incidents.resolution: the route was re-verified after the junction was in place, and the harness now always creates it
incidents.note: the misleading first result is recorded rather than dropped
